title: Extension by zero of modules along the inclusion of an open subscheme: left adjoint to restriction, with stalks
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $U\subseteq X$ an open subscheme with inclusion $j:U\to X$, so that $\mathcal O_U(W)=\mathcal O_X(W)$ for $W\subseteq U$ open. For an $\mathcal O_X$-module $\mathcal G$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] let $\mathcal G|_U$ be the $\mathcal O_U$-module $W\mapsto\mathcal G(W)$ ($W\subseteq U$ open) with the restriction maps of $\mathcal G$, and for a morphism $\psi$ of $\mathcal O_X$-modules let $\psi|_U=(\psi_W)_{W\subseteq U}$ [lem-weil-pbc-module-restriction-open-immersion-colimits]. For an $\mathcal O_U$-module $\mathcal F$ let $j_{p!}\mathcal F$ be the presheaf of $\mathcal O_X$-modules on $X$ with $(j_{p!}\mathcal F)(V)=\mathcal F(V)$ if $V\subseteq U$ and $(j_{p!}\mathcal F)(V)=0$ if $V\not\subseteq U$ ($V\subseteq X$ open), $\mathcal O_X(V)$ acting on $\mathcal F(V)=\mathcal F(V)$ through $\mathcal O_X(V)=\mathcal O_U(V)$ when $V\subseteq U$; the restriction map along $V'\subseteq V$ is the restriction map of $\mathcal F$ if $V\subseteq U$ and $0$ otherwise. A morphism $\alpha:\mathcal F\to\mathcal F'$ gives $j_{p!}\alpha$, equal to $\alpha_V$ for $V\subseteq U$ and $0$ otherwise. Let $\theta_{\mathcal F}:j_{p!}\mathcal F\to j_!\mathcal F$ be the sheafification of $j_{p!}\mathcal F$ as a presheaf of $\mathcal O_X$-modules [def-weil-presheaf-modules-sheafification], and $j_!\alpha$ the morphism induced by $j_{p!}\alpha$; $j_!\mathcal F$ is the *extension of $\mathcal F$ by zero*. Then: (1) $j_!:\Mod(\mathcal O_U)\to\Mod(\mathcal O_X)$ is an additive functor; (2) $j_!$ is left adjoint to restriction: for every $\mathcal O_U$-module $\mathcal F$ and every $\mathcal O_X$-module $\mathcal G$ the map $\Hom_{\mathcal O_X}(j_!\mathcal F,\mathcal G)\to\Hom_{\mathcal O_U}(\mathcal F,\mathcal G|_U)$, $\psi\mapsto(\psi\circ\theta_{\mathcal F})|_U$, is bijective, and natural in $\mathcal F$ and $\mathcal G$; (3) for $x\in X$ with stalks as in [def-weil-pbc-module-stalk]: if $x\notin U$ then $(j_!\mathcal F)_x=0$; if $x\in U$ then the map $\mathcal F_x\to(j_!\mathcal F)_x$, $s_x\mapsto(\theta_{\mathcal F,V}(s))_x$ ($V\subseteq U$ an open neighbourhood of $x$, $s\in\mathcal F(V)$), is well defined and an isomorphism of $\mathcal O_{X,x}$-modules, natural in $\mathcal F$ (for $\alpha:\mathcal F\to\mathcal F'$ it carries $\alpha_x$ to $(j_!\alpha)_x$).

source.place: Sheaves, Lemma 00A7 (label lemma-j-shriek-modules, line 4771) parts (2) and (3), with the definition of extension by zero for modules in Definition 00A4 (label definition-j-shriek-structures, line 4612) parts (1), (2), (5), (6), in Section 009Z (label section-open-immersions); the abelian case is Lemma 00A5 (label lemma-j-shriek-abelian, line 4685).
